welcome.title: Welcome to SEDES
welcome.description: In less than a minute we'll show you the essentials for tracking drought and desertification in Brazil.

items.monitoring: See the indices on the map.
items.analysis: Combine several indices in a multicriteria analysis.

spatialScope.title: Choose where to look
spatialScope.description: Choose the map area: the whole country, a region, a state, a biome, the Semi-arid region or ASD and surroundings. The active index is shown only inside it.

layerCard.title: Each card is an index
layerCard.description: Use the on/off toggle on the left to show the index on the map; the legend appears in the bottom right corner. The “i” explains what the index measures, and Details opens charts, the ranking and the search by state or municipality.

mapSettings.title: Map settings
mapSettings.description: Switch the basemap between Satellite and Street. With an index on, you can also adjust its transparency.

territories.title: Territories
territories.description: Show Indigenous Lands, Quilombola Territories, Settlements and Conservation Units on the map, or search for a territory by name.

replay.title: All set
replay.description: To see this walkthrough again, just click Tour.
